pool_definition: Effective eligible vendor-invoice pool for accelerated-compute platforms/subsystems, including their embedded memory/manufacturing costs, plus network electronics. engine.operating_profit: sum(segment revenue * segment operating_margin) - sbc_separate_deduction_usd_bn - acquired_amortization_separate_deduction_usd_bn - other_normal_operating_cost_usd_bn
engine.note: NVDA/AVGO segment margins are before separately deducted SBC and acquired-intangible amortization; TSMC margin includes both so their separate deductions are zero (not a claim expense is zero). PPE depreciation remains in every operating margin. No equity valuation gains, disposals, discrete tax benefits or nonrecurring credit loss assumed. Debt/guarantee stress shown separately.

benchmark.normalization_note: Own operating-profit plus ordinary net interest bridge at18% tax; exclude equity gains / other nonoperating items; keep SBC and acquired amortization. Quarter*4 is NOT TTM or full-year forecast.

NVDA.expense_basis: Segment operating margins before separate SBC/acquired amortization, after allocated ordinary R&D, SG&A and PPE depreciation. All SBC is then deducted; not company non-GAAP (which includes SBC from FY27).
